headline: Sources: Saints QB Tyler Shough playing with 2 broken bones in non-throwing hand
summary: Saints quarterback Tyler Shough has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, sources told ESPN.

headline: Jalen Hurts will go on injured reserve, miss at least four games and possibly more
summary: Hurts has a blood clot and will not play until Week 11 at the earliest.

headline: Gayle Benson endorses Kellen Moore, coaches after comments about state of Saints
summary: Saints owner Gayle Benson endorsed Kellen Moore and the coaching staff Friday, three days after her pointed comments about the state of the team.
